purpose: IJHE submission metadata and declarations checklist; do not submit while any confirmation is false.
title: Evidence-grounded safety digital twin and direct-answer decision support for a hydrogen refuelling station
ai_disclosure_statement: AI-assisted tools were used to organize KGS-collected source material and draft initial safety and emergency-response materials. The authors must review and verify all quantitative calculations, references, evidence boundaries and final claims, and take responsibility for the article.
data_availability_statement: Confidential station-side records collected by the Korea Gas Safety Corporation (KGS) are not redistributed. The manuscript reports only custodian-approved de-identified/aggregated metrics and uncertainty intervals; public source identifiers, derived metrics and validation manifests are provided where permitted. No reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw trace was identified; this is stated as a limitation.
ethics_statement: No human participants, operator ratings or personal identifiers are included in the physics and engineering validation study. Because suitability depends on each facility, equipment configuration and operating procedure, a facility-specific ethics determination and qualified independent expert review are required before deployment or any claim that SAGA improves human safety decisions.
author_action_required: Confirm institutional email addresses and corresponding-author responsibility.

Confirm competing interests and funding statements.
Approve the AI, data-availability and ethics wording against the final manuscript.
